comparison.objective: Route a cable in a lane and pin it at marked locations with sandbags, not tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable routing and sequential weighted placement; no fine mechanical adjustment, tool use, or dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Cable is straight in the taped lane with a sandbag at each of three marks and all objects released; numeric lane/mark tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests cable-shape control and restraint placement.
